name: When should I consider upgrading to lever door handles?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading to lever door handles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider upgrading to lever door handles if you are renovating your home, looking to improve accessibility, or simply updating your interior design. Levers are particularly beneficial for multi-generational households, individuals with arthritis or limited hand mobility, and commercial properties requiring ADA compliance. They can also enhance the modern aesthetic of a space and often offer smoother operation than older doorknobs. Upgrading during a larger renovation project can also be cost-effective as it can be bundled with other services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade when renovating, needing better accessibility, or updating your home's aesthetic, especially if easier operation is desired.
